title: runner.yaml
description: The machine's runner file, under the user's configuration directory alone: what qory run does on this machine. egress is the run policy's egress section and webhook the webhook configuration, both in the runner contract's grammar, https://qory.dev/contracts/runner/v1/. wall is the container the runtime is started in, that contract's wall.

secret.description: At least 16 characters; may be left out when QORY_WEBHOOK_SECRET is set in the environment.

wall.description: The wall every run on this machine starts the runtime behind: a container with no route out except to the runner's proxy. Absent, the runtime is a process of this machine.

image.description: The agent's image: the runtime and the project's toolchain. qory builds none. May be left out when --image names one.

command.description: The program the adapter runs, podman say. Default docker.

helper.description: The absolute path of a static Linux build of qory, mounted read-only into the container as the relay and the hook forwarder. Default this binary, which only a Linux machine can use.

env.description: Names of variables of qory run's environment that go into the container, the model credential say. Values are never written here. Nothing else of the environment goes in.

user.description: The uid:gid the container runs as. Default qory run's own, so the checkout's files keep their owner. Root is refused; a machine where qory runs as root names another.
